Season year-round written (reported); unsourced potable_water cleared; note cleaned of the unsupported 'water and electric available on site'. Phone and pin corrections flagged. No rate published.
flags: INCLUSION (question): the only official description (ND Tourism) says 'county park with picnic shelters, picnic tables, camping area and fishing pier' and lists 'Tenting' as its only camping amenity: no RV sites, no electric, no water named. Not on the ND HHS licensed RV park/campground list. Imagery shows a mown grass area with two shelters and a fire ring beside a gravel boat-ramp lot (no pads, no RVs visible). A 23-ft rig can drive in on the gravel park road, so it reads as primitive drive-in camping on grass; the stored 'water and electric available on site' (sweep prose) has no official source. Reviewer: keep as primitive camping or treat as tent-only.

PIN: stored 48.3265,-100.7635 sits on the wooded shoreline ~650 m SE of the park. The shelters, camping lawn, boat ramp and fishing pier are at ~48.3310,-100.7690 (Esri imagery). Google's pin 48.32712,-100.76638 is at a road junction ~460 m S of that, also not the park. Move to 48.3310,-100.7690.
